records.description: A flaw has been found in SourceCodester Simple CRUD using PHP and FPDF 1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file app/register.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument firstname can lead to sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

A vulnerability was detected in SourceCodester Online Leave Management System 1.0. Affected is an unknown function of the file app/classes/Master.php of the component Employee Avatar Upload Extension. Performing a manipulation of the argument employee avatar filename results in cross site scripting. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is now public and may be used.

A vulnerability was found in fushengqian fuintCatering up to 6d054f5788ac8645eb491f79242bb8a625efc133. The affected element is the function updateCommissionCash of the file CommissionCashServiceImpl.java. The manipulation of the argument Status results in improper access controls. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. This product takes the approach of rolling releases to provide continious delivery. Therefore, version details for affected and updated releases are not available. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability has been found in fushengqian fuintCatering up to 6d054f5788ac8645eb491f79242bb8a625efc133. Impacted is the function RefundServiceImpl.agreeRefund of the component Refund Agreement. The manipulation leads to improper access controls. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. This product is using a rolling release to provide continious delivery. Therefore, no version details for affected nor updated releases are available. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A flaw has been found in fushengqian fuint up to 36cc31b08d77facc94e8959afa02224891b4fe5f. This issue affects the function receipt of the file ClientOrderController.java. Executing a manipulation can lead to state issue. The attack may be performed from remote. This product utilizes a rolling release system for continuous delivery, and as such, version information for affected or updated releases is not disclosed. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was detected in fushengqian fuint up to 36cc31b08d77facc94e8959afa02224891b4fe5f. This vulnerability affects the function aliPayCallback of the file ClientPayController.java of the component Alipay Callback Handler. Performing a manipulation results in enforcement of behavioral workflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. This product adopts a rolling release strategy to maintain continuous delivery. Therefore, version details for affected or updated releases cannot be specified. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way

A security vulnerability has been detected in fushengqian fuint up to 36cc31b08d77facc94e8959afa02224891b4fe5f. This affects the function confirm of the file MerchantOrderController.java of the component Order Verification. Such manipulation leads to improper access controls. The attack can be executed remotely. This product implements a rolling release for ongoing delivery, which means version information for affected or updated releases is unavailable. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Buffer Overflow in the data receiving process in NEC Corporation WebSAM WinShare Ver 7.5.0 and earlier, Ver 7.6.0 and Ver 7.7.0 through 7.7.2 on Windows allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges via a crafted packet with a malformed data size value in the protocol header.

Improper Input Validation in the network communication processing in NEC Corporation WebSAM WinShare Ver 7.2.0 through 7.5.0, Ver 7.6.0 and Ver 7.7.0 through 7.7.2 on Windows allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands with SYSTEM privileges via a crafted network packet sent to the computer on which WinShare is running.

A weakness has been identified in D-Link DIR-878 1.20B05. Affected by this issue is the function GetListDirectory of the file bin/prog.cgi of the component HNAP Handler. This manipulation of the argument ListDirectoryPath causes path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DIR-878 1.20B05. Affected by this vulnerability is the function SetWanSettings of the component HNAP Handler. The manipulation of the argument Primary/Secondary results in buffer overflow. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-878 1.20B05. Affected is the function SetWanSettings of the component HNAP Handler. The manipulation of the argument ConfigDNS/Primary/ConfigDNS/Secondary leads to buffer overflow. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

A vulnerability was determined in D-Link DIR-878 1.20B05. This impacts the function SetVLANSettings of the file prog.cgi of the component HNAP Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument VID can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

Improper Access Control in the program installation folder in NEC Corporation WebSAM Winshare Ver 7.5.0 and earlier (excluding Ver 7.3.3), Ver 7.6.0 and Ver 7.7.0 through 7.7.1 on Windows allows a locally authenticated low-privileged attacker to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges via a crafted DLL file that is loaded by a SYSTEM-level process.

A vulnerability was found in D-Link DIR-878 1.20B05. This affects the function GetCAPTCHAsetting of the file bin/prog.cgi of the component HNAP Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument uid results in heap-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

A vulnerability has been found in DataLinkDC Dinky up to 1.2.5. The impacted element is the function SqlGateway.onOpen of the file SqlGateway.java of the component sql-gateway Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument connectAddress leads to server-side request forgery. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The researcher claims to have submitted a GHSA on the repository of the project.

A vulnerability was detected in OtterMind Chat2DB up to 5.3.8. Impacted is the function DbMybatisGenerateServiceImpl.generateClass of the file DbMybatisGenerateServiceImpl.java of the component Class Generator. The manipulation of the argument tableName results in path traversal. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security vulnerability has been detected in kekingcn kkFileView up to 5.0.3. This issue affects the function BaseUrlFilter.getBaseUrl of the file server/src/main/java/cn/keking/web/filter/BaseUrlFilter.java. The manipulation of the argument X-Base-Url leads to open redirect. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A weakness has been identified in JeecgBoot 3.9.5. This vulnerability affects the function JimuFormApiService.getTableDictList of the file /jeecg-boot/jmreport/form/getTableDictList of the component Table Dictionary API. Executing a manipulation of the argument searchSql can lead to sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security flaw has been discovered in JeecgBoot 3.9.5. This affects an unknown part of the file /jeecg-boot/drag/onlDragDatasetHead/getAllChartData of the component JimuBI. Performing a manipulation of the argument params results in sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was identified in floci-io Floci up to 2.1.0. The affected element is the function S3Destination.bucketName of the file services/firehose/model/DeliveryStreamDescription.java of the component S3 Destination Configuration Handler. Such manipulation of the argument BucketARN leads to path traversal. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 2.2.0 is sufficient to fix this issue. The name of the patch is b986b95074ef524019be7af51e1df172e48faa4b. You should upgrade the affected component.

A vulnerability was determined in floci-io Floci up to 2.4.0. Impacted is the function BuildspecParser.parseArtifacts of the file src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/codebuild/CodeBuildJsonHandler.java of the component Artifact Handler. This manipulation of the argument buildspecOverride.artifacts.base-directory causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was found in conductor-oss conductor up to 3.32.4/3.33.0/3.34.0-rc3/4.0.0-alpha.1. This issue affects the function WorkflowSystemTask.start of the file PlannerContextFetchTask.java of the component PLANNER_CONTEXT_FETCH Task Handler. The manipulation of the argument url results in server-side request forgery. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The researcher claims to have submitted a GHSA on the repository of the project.

A vulnerability has been found in Dianping CAT 3.0.0/3.1.0/4.0-RC1. This vulnerability affects the function Model.getDomain of the file WEB-INF/tags/hourlyReport.tag of the component Report Handler. The manipulation of the argument domain leads to cross site scripting. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A flaw has been found in Dianping CAT 3.0.0/3.1.0/4.0-RC1. This affects the function Handler.redirect of the file Handler.java of the component Login/Logout. Executing a manipulation of the argument rtnUrl can lead to open redirect. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was detected in erupts erupt up to 2.3.0. Affected by this issue is the function ReportService.queryBiData of the file ReportService.java. Performing a manipulation of the argument sort results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.4.0 can resolve this issue. The patch is named 8d2eaffc79b977c9d11222b9d435a002dceaa062. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in DynamiApps Frontend Admin by DynamiApps acf-frontend-form-element allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Frontend Admin by DynamiApps: from n/a through 3.30.1.

A security vulnerability has been detected in yungifez Skuul School Management System up to 2.6.3. Affected by this vulnerability is the function GraduationController::resetGraduation of the file app/Http/Controllers/GraduationController.php of the component Delete Handler. Such manipulation of the argument student leads to missing authorization. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 3.0.0 addresses this issue. The name of the patch is b42f2c80a8e5e01ca6e607bbd97f137ede368ac9. The affected component should be upgraded

A weakness has been identified in Tidelift moto up to 5.2.4. Affected is an unknown function of the file moto/batch/models.py of the component AWS Batch Emulation. This manipulation of the argument privileged/volumes causes improper privilege management. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security flaw has been discovered in Fengoffice Feng Office up to 3.11.13.11/4.2.1.2. This impacts the function upload_document_image of the file application/controllers/FilesController.class.php of the component File Handler. The manipulation of the argument url results in server-side request forgery. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was identified in Fengoffice Feng Office up to 3.11.13.11/4.2.1.2. This affects the function write_translations of the file application/controllers/ToolController.class.php of the component Translation Tool. The manipulation of the argument lang leads to code injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was determined in Convene Azeus Convene Board Management Portal 7.0.2.7_3 p72. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /jsp/ge/dummy_launcher.jsp. Executing a manipulation of the argument REDIRECT_URL can lead to cross site scripting. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
IBM SevOne Network Performance Management 7.0.0 through 8.2.2 could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service due to uncontrolled resource consumption.
IBM SevOne Network Performance Management 7.0.0 through 8.2.2 could allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary code due to a buffer overflow.

IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1060.00 through FW1060.81, OP940.00 through OP940.A2, OP910.00 through OP910.95, and OP940.00 through OP940.82 could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service due to improper validation of input length.
IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1060.00 through FW1060.81 could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service due to an unhandled exception.

IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1060.00 through FW1060.81, OP940.00 through OP940.A2, OP910.00 through OP910.95, and  OP940.00 through OP940.82 could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service due to improper restriction of excessive computational resources.

IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1120.00 through FW1120.01, FW1110.00 through FW1110.31, FW1060.00 through FW1060.81, OP940.00 through OP940.A2, OP910.00 through OP910.95, and OP940.00 through OP940.82 could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service due to improper handling of uninitialized resources.
IBM webMethods Integration Server 12.1 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper authentication.
IBM Bob 1.0.4 through 2.0.1 could allow a remote attacker to inject arbitrary code on the system, due to the improper control of user input code.

IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.2 An authenticated flow author could write attacker-controlled file content into any directory writable by the service account, bypassing the platform's local file access isolation safeguard. Via a crafted on-disk index, the attacker could also read the contents of arbitrary files accessible to the service process — including configuration files, secrets, or database files stored under the application's data directory.

Hibernate Validator could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service due to uncontrolled resource consumption resulting from improper escaping of user-controlled data in Expression Language (EL) expressions.

IBM Process Mining 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service through insufficient rate limiting of email notifications, resulting in excessive emails being sent to targeted recipients.

IBM Security Verify Directory 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and IBM Verify Directory 11.0.0 accepts GET requests for authentication, allowing credentials to be passed as URL parameters. This causes passwords to be exposed in browser history and server logs.

IBM Security Verify Directory 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and IBM Verify Directory 11.0.0 exposes debug endpoints that disclose system information including server versions and session identifiers. This information can be used to identify vulnerable software versions.

IBM Security Verify Directory 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and IBM Verify Directory 11.0.0 does not set the SameSite attribute on session cookies, making it vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks. An attacker can cause authenticated users' browsers to send unauthorized requests to the application.

IBM Security Verify Directory 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and IBM Verify Directory 11.0.0 is vulnerable to session fixation. An attacker can establish a session and, after the victim authenticates, hijack the authenticated session to gain unauthorized access to the directory management console.
IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2.4 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory.
IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2.4 could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper validation of CSRF tokens for GET requests.
IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2.4 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper input validation.
IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2.4 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands due to improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command.
IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2.4 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands due to improper neutralization of argument delimiters.
IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to delete arbitrary files due to path traversal.

IBM Sterling B2B Integrator 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1, 6.2.2.0 - 6.2.2.1_1 and IBM Sterling File Gateway 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1, 6.2.2.0 - 6.2.2.1_1 Standard Edition could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper logging of sensitive credentials.
IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to an XML external entity (XXE) injection flaw.
IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 is affected by an information disclosure vulnerability due to unsafe class reflection in the JMX REST connector body parser.
IBM Guardium Key Lifecycle Manager 4.1, 4.1.1, 4.2, 4.2.1, 5.0, and 5.1 could allow a local attacker to obtain sensitive information due to the use of a weak cryptographic algorithm.

IBM i 7.6, 7.5, 7.4, and 7.3 could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information from the Host-Based Printer Subsystem due to no authorization check. A bad actor could use this vulnerability to print files they should not be able to access.

IBM Content Navigator 3.0.15.0, 26.0.0.0, 3.1.0.0, and 3.2.0.0 is vulnerable to LDAP injection. A remote authenticated attacker could send a specially crafted request that could allow enumeration of LDAP directory information.

IBM Concert 1.0 through 3.0.1.1 allows an attacker can supply crafted input that is incorporated into an operating system command without adequate validation or sanitization. Successful exploitation allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system with the privileges of the affected service.

IBM Cloud Pak for Data System 11.3.1.2 Interim Fix 001 through - 11.3.1.2 Interim Fix 002 could allow a user with administrative privileges to read and write arbitrary files on the system due to incorrect permission assignments.

IBM watsonx Orchestrate Cartridge for Cloud Pak for Data 4.8.4 through 4.8.5, and 5.0.0 through 5.4.2 allows low-privileged users to execute administrative functions by directly invoking backend APIs.As a result, UI-level access restrictions are ineffective, as the backend fails to enforce role-based access control.

IBM watsonx Orchestrate Cartridge for Cloud Pak for Data 4.8.4 through 4.8.5, and 5.0.0 through 5.4.2 fails to enforce backend authorization checks, allowing low‑privileged users to directly invoke administrative API endpoints. This bypasses UI‑level access restrictions and may lead to unauthorized execution of privileged functions.

IBM Sterling B2B Integrator 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1 and 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1, and IBM Sterling File Gateway 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1 and 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1 Standard Edition could allow a remote authenticated attacker to access unauthorized pages due to improper authorization.
IBM Storage TS4500 Library 1.1.1.6 through 1.12.0.3 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to perform unauthorized account takeover due to improper authorization.
IBM CockroachDB PostgreSQL for IBM VPC 26.2.0 through 26.2.3, 25.4.0 through 25.4.12, and 25.2.0 through 25.2.20 is vulnerable to privilege escalation via user-defined function.

IBM Storage Scale System 6.2.3.0 through 6.2.3.6, and 7.0.0.0 through 7.0.1.0 and IBM Storage Scale 6.0.0.0 through 6.0.1.0, and 5.2.3.0 through 5.2.3.8 could allow an attacker to leverage an undocumented flag to gain access to an unauthenticated path in the REST API.
IBM Sterling File Gateway 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1 and  6.2.2.0 - 6.2.2.1_1 could allow a remote attacker to perform protocol downgrade attacks due to a security misconfiguration.

IBM CockroachDB PostgreSQL for IBM VPC 26.2.0 through 26.2.3, 25.4.0 through 25.4.12, and 25.2.0 through 25.2.20 is vulnerable to server-side request forgery (SSRF). This may allow an authenticated attacker to send unauthorized requests from the system, potentially leading to network enumeration or facilitating other attacks.
IBM Secure Proxy 6.1.0.0 through 6.2.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service due to improper validation of listener IP address and port.
IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service due to improper slug normalization causing tool name collisions.
IBM App Connect Enterprise 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2, and 12.0.1.0 through 12.0.12.30 could allow a remote attacker to inject arbitrary HTML due to improper output neutralization.
IBM App Connect Enterprise 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2, and 12.0.1.0 through 12.0.12.30 could allow a remote attacker to perform content spoofing due to improper output encoding of error messages.
IBM App Connect Enterprise 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2 could allow a remote attacker to perform unauthorized actions due to missing anti-clickjacking controls.
IBM App Connect Enterprise 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to broken access control.
IBM Optim 1.0.0, 1.1.0, and 1.2.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to path traversal.

IBM App Connect Enterprise 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2, and 12.0.1.0 through 12.0.12.29 could allow a local attacker to perform an arbitrary file write due to improper validation of pathnames during archive extraction.
IBM Netezza Appliance 11.3.0.2 Interim Fix 002 through 11.3.1.3 Interim Fix 006 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to change the passwords of other users due to improper authorization.
IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to write arbitrary files due to a path traversal vulnerability.
IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to write arbitrary files due to a path traversal vulnerability.
IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary scripts due to improper neutralization of input in the X-Forwarded-Host header.
IBM Concert 1.0 through 3.0.1.1 contains components that allow potentially unsafe command execution, which could be exploited to run arbitrary system commands on the host.
IBM Cognos Command Center 10.2.4.1 and 10.2.5 could allow a remote attacker to execute unauthorized processes due to cross-site request forgery.
IBM Storage Scale 5.2.3.0 through 5.2.3.9 and 6.0.1.0  could allow an authenticated attacker to access and manipulate filesets beyond their control due to improper authorization.

IBM Storage Scale 5.2.3.0 through 5.2.3.9 and 6.0.1.0 could allow a remote attacker to traverse directories on the system. An attacker could send a specially crafted URL request containing "dot dot" sequences (/../) to view arbitrary files on the system.

IBM Turbonomic kubeturbo agent 8.16.0 through 8.20.3 does not validate or improperly validates TLS certificate validation, which could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive information using man in the middle techniques.

IBM Turbonomic kubeturbo agent 8.16.0 through 8.21.2 does not validate or improperly validates TLS certificate validation, which could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive information using man in the middle techniques.

IBM Turbonomic kubeturbo agent 8.16.0 through 8.21.2 is vulnerable to server-side request forgery (SSRF). This may allow an authenticated attacker to send unauthorized requests from the system, potentially leading to network enumeration or facilitating other attacks.

IBM Storage Scale 5.2.3.0 through 5.2.3.8, and 6.0.1.0 does not validate or improperly validates TLS certificate validation when communicating with remote cluster GUI interfaces, which could allow an attacker to inject forged JSON responses using man in the middle techniques.

IBM Sterling B2B Integrator 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1 and IBM Sterling File Gateway 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1 stores potentially sensitive information in log files that could be read by a local privileged user.
IBM Controller Disclosure Management 1.0.0.0 could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive EXIF metadata from uploaded images due to improper removal of sensitive information before storage.

IBM Aspera Connect 1.6.1 through 4.2.19 fails to consistently enforce origin verification across all REST API endpoints. An attacker who convinces a user to visit a malicious website could delete or inspect account configurations.

IBM Aspera Connect 1.6.1 through 4.2.19 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information and modify host trust configuration due to missing authentication and overly permissive cross-origin access controls in the local HTTP service. By persuading a victim to visit a malicious web page, an attacker could perform unauthorized cross-origin requests to read and modify configuration.
IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 is affected by a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the Admin Center deploy validation endpoint.
IBM Storage Copy Data Management 2.2 could allow an authenticated user to execute arbitrary commands with normal user privileges on the system due to improper validation of user supplied input.
IBM webMethods Integration Server 12.1 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper authentication.
IBM Qiskit SDK 2.4.0 through 2.6.1 could allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary code due to an out-of-bounds write caused by improper input validation when accessing a corrupted unitary matrix.
IBM Qiskit SDK 2.4.0 through 2.6.1 could allow a local attacker to cause a denial of service due to unbound recursion during deserialization of untrusted QPY payloads.
IBM Qiskit SDK 1.4.2 through 2.6.2 could allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary code due to deserialization of untrusted data.

IBM Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus 8.1.0 through 8.1.0.41 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting. This vulnerability allows an authenticated user to embed arbitrary JavaScript code in the Web UI thus altering the intended functionality potentially leading to credentials disclosure within a trusted session.
IBM Process Mining 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper access control.
IBM Db2 11.5.0 through 11.5.9, and 12.1.0 through 12.1.5 is vulnerable to a denial of service when executing a specially crafted query with a Materialized Query Table.
IBM Process Mining 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 could allow an authenticated user to perform unauthorized actions due to client-side enforcement of sever side security mechanisms.

IBM TRIRIGA Application Platform 5.0.0 through 5.0.9 IBM TRIRIGA could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code due to improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command.
IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 could allow a remote attacker to conduct phishing attacks.
IBM Process Mining 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 could allow an authenticated user to upload a file with dangerous types that could be executed by another user if opened.
IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 could allow an authenticated user with the Reader role to obtain sensitive information.
IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to an absolute-path traversal vulnerability.
IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability.

IBM QRadar 7.5.0 through 7.5.0 Update Pack 16 Interim Fix 02, and 7.6.0.0 through 7.6.0.5 is vulnerable to Reflected XSS. A victim must open a specifically crafted URL while authenticated to QRadar to trigger this.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Melapress Melapress Role Editor melapress-role-editor allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Melapress Role Editor: from n/a through 1.3.0.
IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 could allow an authenticated user with the Reader role to obtain sensitive information.
IBM i 7.6, 7.5, 7.4, and 7.3 could allow an authenticated user to indirectly disable system auditing, which they otherwise don't have authority to disable.
IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale 8.6.1.0 through 8.6.2.2 could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper Content Security Policy configuration.

IBM Safer Payments 6.4.0.00 through 6.4.2.11, 6.5.0.00 through 6.5.0.09, 6.6.0.00 through 6.6.0.07, 6.7.0.00 through 6.7.0.03, and 6.8.0.00 could allow an authenticated user to obtain sensitive information, caused by improper user input validation. By using a set of API requests the user could exploit this vulnerability to decrypt sensitive information.

IBM watsonx Orchestrate Cartridge for Cloud Pak for Data 4.8.4 through 4.8.5, and 5.0.0 through 5.4.2 could allow an authenticated user to perform unauthorized actions due to improper trust of server-side permission methods.
IBM watsonx Orchestrate Cartridge for Cloud Pak for Data 4.8.4 through 4.8.5, and 5.0.0 through 5.4.2 could disclose sensitive source code information that should not be accessible.

IBM Engineering Requirements Management DOORS Next 7.1, and 7.2 could allow a remote attacker to force the Web server to return contents of a sensitive requested file due to improper input validation.

BabelDOC from 0.3.61 before 0.7.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU and memory by supplying unbounded bfrange and cidrange spans. Attackers can submit a crafted PDF whose embedded ToUnicode CMap declares a huge range, driving billions of loop iterations and stalling the translation worker.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Shorewall and Shorewall6 modules' list.cgi, which renders table fields and COMMENT lines unescaped. Authenticated users with table edit permission can store JavaScript via savecmt.cgi or table entries that executes when other users, including root, view the list page.

ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users of any organization to clone other tenants' courses via the POST /course/:courseId/clone endpoint. Attackers who know a target course id can copy its sections, lessons, exercises, and quiz answer keys into their own organization, exposing private course content.

SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the html.clean() sanitizer's _normalizeURL() function decodes named entities like : to an empty string. Attackers can inject href values such as javascript: that pass the _isSafeURL() check but are decoded by browsers, executing JavaScript when victims click stored links.

SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the DocumentType constructor that injects header textContent into innerHTML without HTML escaping. Attackers can store entity-encoded HTML in h1-h6 headers that executes JavaScript when editors using document:header mode initialize, enabling session cookie theft.

SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ModalAnchorEditor's #createBookmarkList, which inserts entity-decoded h1-h6 header textContent into the bookmark list via innerHTML without escaping. Attackers can store HTML-encoded payloads in editor headers that execute JavaScript when a victim opens the link modal and types # in the URL input.

SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the FileUpload plugin create() method that assigns server-returned file names to innerHTML without escaping. Attackers can upload files with HTML-laden names that bypass html.clean() and execute JavaScript in victims' browsers when content or gallery items load, enabling session theft.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the RingCentral RCFaxClient disposeDocument() method of oe-module-faxsms that allows authenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary files via the file_path parameter. Attackers can use action=download to read credentials and source code, or action=setup with base64 content to write web-executable files for code execution.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability in portal/portal_payment.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to bypass billing ACL checks by tampering patient identifiers. Attackers can modify the pid and form_pid parameters to view payment pages and record fraudulent payment receipts for arbitrary patients, corrupting billing records.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated clinicians lacking high-sensitivity permission to read and modify encounter-bound forms via load_form.php. Attackers can request the Clinical Notes or Care Plan direct loader to obtain restricted content and a CSRF token, then submit save.php to tamper with clinical records.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the non-patient POST /fhir/DocumentReference/$docref route that allows low-privileged users to generate any patient's CCDA. Attackers with only demographics and documents permissions can supply a victim patient parameter, then download the full-chart CCDA from Patient Documents to exfiltrate clinical data.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the classic document controller that allows low-privilege authenticated users to recategorize other patients' documents. Attackers can invoke move_action_process to move a document into a patients|demo category, then retrieve it with an empty patient_id to exfiltrate PHI and tamper with charts.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the patient portal onsitedocuments API that allows authenticated patients to read other patients' documents by overriding query criteria. Attackers can send empty pid_Equals and denialReason_IsNotLike parameters to remove patient scoping and locked filters, exposing consent bodies, signatures, file paths, and template data.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in portal onsite-document APIs that allows any authenticated core user to access cross-patient documents. Attackers can omit the patientId parameter and supply arbitrary record IDs to list, read, and overwrite other patients' portal documents, signatures, and template data.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability because the prescription REST API routes check the patients.med ACL instead of patients.rx and request no specific permission bit, so read-only Medical/History access passes the check. Authenticated staff users can reuse the UI-exposed APICSRFTOKEN to enumerate prescription UUIDs, forge prescriptions for arbitrary patients, and deactivate existing prescriptions tenant-wide.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass allowing low-privileged SMART standalone-launch users to bind arbitrary patient UUIDs into the OAuth token context. Attackers with only the patients|demo ACL can select a victim during authorization and read that patient's clinical notes and documents through patient-scoped DocumentReference and Binary FHIR endpoints.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in Rainforest patient portal payments that trusts browser-supplied patientId, encounter, and amount values instead of deriving them from the portal session. Authenticated portal patients can tamper with JSON sent to portal_payment.rainforest.php so the payin.authorized webhook writes forged ar_activity credits to other patients' encounters exceeding the amount actually paid.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read cross-patient FHIR QuestionnaireResponse data by sending the APICSRFTOKEN header. Attackers can reuse the session-exposed api_csrf_token_js value to skip FHIR scope checks and call GET /fhir/QuestionnaireResponse, exfiltrating site-wide questionnaire answer PHI.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an arbitrary local file read vulnerability in REST document download, where the controller passes stored uploaded document bytes to Symfony's BinaryFileResponse as a filesystem path instead of returning them as content. Authenticated users with document upload and download access can upload a document containing an absolute pathname, such as the sqlconf.php location, then download it to read server files and recover database credentials.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the addRecall action of /interface/main/messages/save.php that allows low-privileged authenticated users to modify arbitrary patients' recall data. Attackers can submit a crafted new_pid with recall, contact, provider, facility, and notification preference fields to overwrite records of patients they cannot access.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete arbitrary patient recall records via the delete_Recall action. Attackers can send POST requests to /interface/main/messages/save.php with a target pid and r_ID to remove recall data without ACL or ownership checks.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference in portal/lib/paylib.php, which writes the request-supplied form_pid (or the patient_id_cc value in Sphere data) to onsite_portal_activity without checking it against the session patient. Authenticated portal patients can submit portal-save, review-save, AuthorizeNet, Stripe, or Sphere requests to insert or modify forged payment-audit records in other patients' billing records.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in portal/lib/persist.php that allows authenticated portal patients to modify other patients' settings by supplying an arbitrary setting_patient value. Attackers can insert or overwrite patient_settings rows for victims to suppress notifications, tamper with consent flags, or alter portal preferences.

MRBS (Meeting Room Booking System) before 1.12.3 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script via the error parameter of view_entry.php. Attackers can send crafted links to logged-in users to read CSRF tokens, modify or delete bookings, or perform administrative actions.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability in the SOAP note update API, which does not verify that the supplied SOAP note ID (sid) belongs to the supplied patient and encounter. Authenticated users with encounters/notes permission can send PUT requests to /api/patient/:pid/encounter/:eid/soap_note/:sid with another patient's sid to overwrite that clinical note and reassign its pid.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_patient_note.php that allows any authenticated user to read and modify patient billing notes. Attackers with low-privilege accounts can enumerate the patient_id parameter and submit POST requests using the embedded CSRF token to view or tamper with confidential billing data.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_invoice.php that allows any authenticated user to read and modify billing data for any encounter. Attackers can iterate the id parameter to read patient names and billing notes, and post payments, adjustments, deletions, or billing notes against any patient's account.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken object level authorization vulnerability in portal/report/portal_custom_report.php that allows authenticated portal patients to read other patients' problem list entries. Attackers can enumerate sequential IDs in issue_ parameter names to retrieve other patients' problem titles, clinical notes, ICD diagnosis codes, and IPPF contraceptive records.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Fee Sheet drug-inventory lookup (DrugSalesService::sellDrug) that interpolates the prod[N][warehouse] POST field into an ORDER BY clause. Low-privileged authenticated users can submit Fee Sheet product lines with constant subqueries to run a time-based blind oracle, extracting patient data and users_secure bcrypt hashes.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Standard REST API patient insurance and employer search, which concatenates query-string parameter names into SQL as column identifiers without escaping. Authenticated clients, including low-privilege patient-portal OAuth2 tokens, can send crafted parameter names to /api/patient/{puuid}/insurance or /api/patient/{puuid}/employer to extract patient PHI, user records, and API client secrets.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains a local file inclusion in the ESign router (library/ESign/Router.php), which passes the unsanitized module parameter into a require_once of '<module>/Controller.php', and the fax module's faxProcessUploads writes attacker-named files to a predictable temp path without extension checks. Authenticated attackers can upload a PHP file named Controller.php, then request interface/esign/index.php with a traversing module parameter to include it and execute arbitrary code.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to make the server send HTTP requests by registering an OAuth2 client with an unvalidated jwks_uri. Attackers can trigger the fetch via the token introspection endpoint with an unsigned client_assertion to probe internal services and reach cloud metadata endpoints.

Trendyol kafka-konsumer from 2.3.3 before 2.6.18 contains a denial of service vulnerability in batch_consumer.go that panics when a single record exceeds MessageGroupByteSizeLimit. Attackers able to produce to the consumed topic can publish one oversized record that terminates the consumer before offset commit, causing a persistent crash loop.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows patient-scoped SMART tokens to read other patients' questionnaire responses because FhirQuestionnaireResponseService does not implement IPatientCompartmentResourceService. Attackers holding a patient/QuestionnaireResponse.rs token can request responses by uuid or list the unfiltered bundle to obtain cross-patient clinical assessment answers.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with CAMOS access to inject HTML by saving malicious CAMOS content through ajax_save.php. Attackers can store a script payload that executes unencoded when the entry is printed via the non-print_html branch of rx_print.php, performing actions and reading data as the victim user.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in OnsiteDocumentController::Query() that allows authenticated portal patients to bypass the lowercase pid authorization guard by supplying a capitalised Pid parameter. Attackers can request the api/onsitedocuments endpoint with Pid set to another patient's id to overwrite the session-pinned criteria and read other patients' onsite documents containing PHI.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in library/ajax/upload.php that allows any authenticated user to read and overwrite document data by supplying an arbitrary doc_id. Low-privilege users can enumerate doc_id values with the fetch and save actions to disclose patient health information and tamper with medical records across all patients.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in PortalPatientController::Read() that allows authenticated patients to read other patients' pending demographic change requests. Attackers can supply another patient's ID in the patientId query string parameter to retrieve PHI including names, addresses, SSNs, and insurance information.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in many encounter-form view and save endpoints that lack patient/encounter ownership checks. Authenticated clinical users can enumerate sequential form id values in requests such as soap/view.php and save.php to read and overwrite other patients' clinical records.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the FHIR GET /fhir/Person/:uuid route that allows patient-portal users to read any staff member's demographics by bypassing compartment enforcement. Attackers holding a patient SMART token with patient/Person.read can harvest staff Person UUIDs from Appointment references to retrieve names, home addresses, phone numbers, and personal emails.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_process.php that allows authenticated users to write and read files by supplying unsanitized eraname values. Attackers without billing privileges can inject ../ sequences to create ERA report .html files anywhere the web user can write and parse arbitrary .edi files echoed into the report.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains missing authorization and insecure direct object reference vulnerabilities in the oe-module-prior-authorizations module that allow authenticated low-privilege users to access and modify other patients' records. Attackers can request public/reports/list_report.php to view all patients' names, MRNs, insurance and prior-auth data, or submit arbitrary id values to public/index.php to overwrite other patients' prior-authorization records.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in OnsiteDocumentController::Query() that allows authenticated portal patients to read other patients' documents by overriding Pid_Equals criteria. Attackers can supply Pid_Equals, Pid_GreaterThan, or Pid_In request parameters to the onsitedocuments API to retrieve signed consent forms, signatures, and PHI of any patient.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in portal/lib/persist.php that allows authenticated portal patients to write settings for other patients. Attackers can modify the setting_patient parameter in a JSON POST request to another patient's PID, altering that patient's portal settings such as the portal theme.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in interface/forms/eye_mag/report.php that allows authenticated users to inject scripts by adding unescaped document notes. Attackers with document-note write access can store malicious JavaScript in a retina document note that executes when clinicians generate the Eye Exam patient report, exposing session cookies.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in its SMART on FHIR implementation because checkUserHasAccessToPatient() in BearerTokenAuthorizationStrategy.php unconditionally returns true. Authenticated users or malicious SMART apps can manipulate token launch context to bind requests to arbitrary patient UUIDs, gaining unauthorized read/write access to other patients' FHIR resources.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken access control and path traversal vulnerability in the fax/sms module disposeDocument action via an unvalidated file_path parameter. Authenticated low-privilege users can read sqlconf.php to recover database credentials and write arbitrary files as the web user, enabling remote code execution.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in FHIR Media/:uuid and QuestionnaireResponse read routes that skip ACL checks. Non-patient API tokens lacking OpenEMR ACLs can request resources by uuid, bypassing compartment filtering to read any patient's documents and questionnaire responses.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the CCDA/CCD preview stylesheets, where cda.xsl copies event-handler attributes whose values evade a character denylist and ccd.xsl copies table-cell attributes unsanitized into preview HTML. Authenticated users can upload a crafted CCDA/CCD document with onmouseover, onclick, or onfocus handlers to execute script in a clinician's session when previewed.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in OnsitePortalActivityController::Update() that checks the request's patientId instead of the stored record's owner. Authenticated portal patients can send PUT requests to the onsiteportalactivity API with another patient's activity id and their own patientId to disclose tableArgs and checksum data, overwrite narratives and status, and take ownership of the record.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the FaxSMS module's RCFaxClient and SignalWireClient disposeDocument functions that allows authenticated low-privilege users to read and overwrite arbitrary files via the unsanitized file_path parameter. Attackers can request action=download to retrieve cleartext files like sqlconf.php database credentials and keys, or use action=setup to overwrite web-server-writable files with ciphertext.

OpenEMR from 7.0.1 before 8.4.0 contains a flaw in src/Common/Auth/OneTimeAuth.php that ignores the enforce_onetime_use and max_access_count flags, never revokes consumed service_auth tokens, and checks login_pin without rate limiting or strict comparison. Attackers holding a captured token can replay it or brute-force the PIN to open patient-portal sessions exposing PHI.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in the patient portal OnsiteDocument query API that lets request parameters set bitwise criteria filters whose values are placed unquoted into the SQL WHERE clause. Authenticated patient portal users can inject SQL via parameters such as Id_BitwiseAnd to read any database table, including other patients' records and staff password hashes.

Frappe Framework before 15.121.1 and 16.x before 16.35.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability in File list and report queries that fails to restrict private file records to authorized users. Authenticated users can query File list or report views to obtain metadata of private files they are not permitted to access.

AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows users with station WebHooks permission to bypass the UserUrlFilter SSRF guard through HTTP redirects. Attackers can configure Mastodon, Telegram, GroupMe, or RadioReg webhooks pointing to a redirecting URL, causing the Guzzle client to reach internal services and expose responses via test logs.

Kyverno before 1.19.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows namespaced tenants to generate any resource kind in any namespace by templating the generate rule's kind and namespace with variables. Attackers can create a Policy and trigger ConfigMap in their own namespace, causing the privileged background-controller to write NetworkPolicies or RoleBindings into victim or kube-system namespaces.

Kyverno from 1.19.1 before 1.19.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the apiCall namespace clamp that allows namespace tenants to issue cross-namespace and cluster-scoped API requests by appending malformed percent-escapes to urlPath. Attackers can create namespaced Policies whose apiCall runs as the admission-controller ServiceAccount to read other namespaces' resources and create mutating webhooks, escalating to cluster admin.

Scriban and Scriban.Signed before 7.5.3 contain uncontrolled recursion flaws in which postfix member, indexer, and call chains bypass ExpressionDepthLimit, array comparison lacks depth and cycle checks, and object.eval bypasses RecursiveLimit. Attackers who can supply templates can trigger an uncatchable StackOverflowException that terminates the host process.

Scriban before 7.5.2 contains an information disclosure and object manipulation vulnerability that allows template authors to access .NET internals of function values through reflection member accessors. Attackers can use array.map to read Target, Method, or ReturnType on imported delegates, exposing and overwriting service properties, captured closure secrets, and assembly paths.

Scriban before 7.5.3 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows untrusted template authors to exhaust memory and CPU because builtins like math.format, regex.replace and string.escape skip the LimitToString allocation guard. Attackers can submit small templates using huge format precision specifiers, shared-structure array comparison, BigInteger multiplication or exponential function recursion that ignore LoopLimit and CancellationToken, crashing or stalling multi-tenant hosts.

OpenRemote before 1.32.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows realm administrators to access and modify global resources by calling admin endpoints lacking super administrator checks. Attackers can change the global keycloakUrl via /configuration/manager to redirect other realms' console authentication for credential phishing, inject CSS, replace map tiles, and delete logs.

OpenRemote before 1.32.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with write:admin permissions to upload HTML or SVG files containing JavaScript via the Manager configuration file upload endpoint. Attackers can lure victims to the unauthenticated image retrieval endpoint, which serves files as text/html or image/svg+xml, executing scripts within the application's origin.

Grav Lightbox Gallery plugin 1.1.0 before 1.3.2 on Grav 2.x calls any medium method named in image, thumb or thumb_options shortcode values without core's allowed media action check. A page editor can chain addMetaFile with value, toYaml or toJson to read server-readable YAML files, such as account password hashes, 2FA secrets and API keys, into a publicly viewable page.

phpMyFAQ before 4.1.11 contains an insufficient authorization vulnerability that allows delegated administrators holding only GROUP_DELETE permission to delete higher-privileged groups. Attackers can submit a target group_list_select value to /admin/group/confirm and then /admin/group/delete to remove privileged groups, their memberships, and permission mappings.

phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.11 and 4.2.0 pre-releases before 4.2.0-beta.3 contain an account enumeration vulnerability in the unauthenticated POST /api/webauthn/prepare-login endpoint, which returns stable stored credential IDs for passkey-registered accounts but an md5(time())-derived fallback ID otherwise. Unauthenticated attackers can compare allowCredentials IDs from requests sent more than one second apart, without rate limiting, to identify existing passkey-registered accounts and their credential IDs.

Craft CMS from 5.10.0 before 5.11.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to browse volumes they lack permissions for. Attackers can delete a linked asset and use the replacement volume browser modal to view directory structures of all volumes, though not file contents.

Craft CMS from 5.10.0 before 5.11.2 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows non-administrator control panel users to obtain HMAC-signed Twig templates via the app/render-elements endpoint. Attackers can submit the signed templated returnUrl as the login redirect parameter, triggering unsandboxed renderObjectTemplate() evaluation and executing OS commands as the PHP worker.

Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated public registrants to reclaim deactivated non-admin accounts while retaining their direct permissions. Attackers can register using a deactivated account, set a new password, and inherit permissions stored in userpermissions_users, enabling privileged account takeover when email verification is disabled.

Craft CMS from 5.7.0 before 5.11.2 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows authenticated control panel users to read SVG files by posting arbitrary paths to the app/icon-svg endpoint. Attackers can supply aliases or absolute paths, which are resolved without permission checks, to read any SVG-content file readable by the PHP process, including files outside the Craft installation.

Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous GraphQL clients to read out-of-scope section entries via prev/next fields. Attackers can chain next hops from one visible in-scope entry to enumerate entries and read titles, slugs, and custom-field content from withheld sections.

Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read content from sites outside a GraphQL schema's Sites scope. Attackers can send a POST request to /actions/graphql/api selecting the localized field without the siteId argument to disclose out-of-scope site content.

Parse Server 8.6.109 before 8.6.116 and 9.10.6-alpha.1 before 9.10.7-alpha.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in which create or update responses mark fields as deleted based on stored values the caller cannot read. Attackers with write but not read access to an object can inspect these markers to infer whether protected fields are set.

WWBN AVideo contains a path traversal vulnerability in plugin/AI/receiveAsync.json.php that allows holders of any valid AI token to write arbitrary .vtt files by injecting traversal sequences into the unsanitized response[lang] parameter. Attackers can send a type=translation request with a crafted lang value to plant attacker-controlled content in the webroot or overwrite other users' subtitle files.

A vulnerability was identified in Jinher OA C6. This impacts an unknown function of the file /C6/JHSoft.Web.Project/OfficeReadOnly/ProjectAfficheManage.aspx. Such manipulation of the argument ProjID leads to sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was determined in FlowCI flow-core-x up to 1.23.49. This affects the function exist/save/read/remove of the file store/src/main/java/com/flowci/store/LocalFileManager.java of the component LocalFileManager. This manipulation of the argument fileName causes path traversal. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. A high degree of complexity is needed for the attack. The exploitability is reported as difficult. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was found in FlowCI flow-core-x up to 1.23.49. The impacted element is the function FileHelper.unzip of the file common/src/main/java/com/flowci/common/helper/FileHelper.java. The manipulation results in path traversal. The attack may be performed from remote. A high complexity level is associated with this attack. The exploitability is regarded as difficult. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability has been found in FlowCI flow-core-x up to 1.23.49. The affected element is the function ConditionManagerImpl.run of the file core/src/main/java/com/flowci/core/common/manager/ConditionManagerImpl.java of the component Groovy Script Evaluation. The manipulation of the argument condition leads to code injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A flaw has been found in DataLinkDC Dinky up to 1.2.5. Impacted is the function file.getOriginalFilename of the file CatalogueController.java of the component Catalogue Upload. Executing a manipulation of the argument filename can lead to path traversal. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The researcher claims to have submitted a GHSA on the repository of the project.

The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not sanitize a persisted field definition before emitting part of it as an HTML attribute name, allowing a user able to configure its fields to store a payload that executes as JavaScript in the browser of any user who views a page rendering the affected field, which on multisite lets a site administrator who lacks the unfiltered_html capability inject script into other users' sessions.

The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not perform a read-permission check when it renders and formats the values of its relational fields, allowing users with post-editing access (Contributor and above) to disclose the titles and non-public statuses of other users' unpublished posts.

The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not verify that a user is allowed to edit the target object before writing to it during bidirectional relationship synchronization, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to add or remove a reference to their own object on arbitrary posts, users, or terms they cannot otherwise edit.

The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not re-apply its field-group location rules when persisting values submitted through the post editor save path, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to write custom fields the site restricted to administrators onto their own posts.

The Pie Register  WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 does not perform an authorisation check in one of its AJAX actions, allowing users with a role as low as contributor to modify existing administrator-created invitation-code records.

The Pie Register  WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 does not perform any capability, nonce or authentication check on one of its request handlers, allowing unauthenticated attackers to reset the Pie Register  WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15's settings to their defaults (disabling registration security controls such as new-user email verification) and to destroy a Pie Register  WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 data table.

The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin before 7.5.57.7212 does not perform any authorization check on an AJAX action that carries out a site-wide content rewrite, so any authenticated user, including subscriber-level, can trigger a bulk modification of posts they should not be able to edit.

The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.0 does not perform authorisation or a valid nonce check on its ticket-transfer feature, which is available to unauthenticated users, allowing them to transfer other attendees' guest-checkout tickets to an email address of their choosing, invalidating the legitimate ticket and causing the victim's ticket PDF, which contains attendee personal data, to be sent to the attacker.

The Pronamic Pay WordPress plugin before 11.1.0, Pronamic Pay doneren met Mollie WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 do not restrict access to stored form submissions through the REST API, allowing unauthenticated users to read the messages that visitors submitted through the bundled forms.

The WP Recipe Maker WordPress plugin before 10.9.2 does not check whether the post a recipe is embedded in is password protected before returning the recipe through its REST API and structured data output, allowing unauthenticated users to read the full content of recipes in password-protected posts.

The Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 6.2.4 does not validate the type or extension of files uploaded through a form file field, and a flaw in its temporary-file cleanup leaves the uploaded file on disk, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files to the site. On a stock Debian or Ubuntu Apache configuration, which lists directory contents and maps .phar to the PHP handler, the stored file can be located and executed, leading to Remote Code Execution.
